title: Cori R NDE 4881
content: I was having extremely bad headaches for about five days prior to this happening. I had gone to the doctor and was told it was my sinuses. The pain and pressure continued to get much worse and I wasn't able to sleep during the night. After a painful, sleepless night, I had gotten up early and decided to lay on the couch while my eleven year old daughter watched TV. The next thing I knew I was on a path with 'blurry' beings on each side. They didn't look like 'people' but I knew they were. The colors were very earth tone. As I floated down the path, there to the right I saw my dog Molly, who had passed away about seven months before. The next thing I knew, I was at the end of the path. It felt so good. Then I heard my daughter, from what seemed a million miles away crying 'Mommy! Mommy! What's wrong?!' I heard her, but I didn't want to go. She cried again very, very faintly. I again said to myself 'I don't want to go. I won't go!' It felt so good there, no pain at all, so peaceful and cozy. I felt so good. Just then, one of my dogs literally jumped on my chest and stuck her tongue in my mouth! I was then almost 'slammed' back in to reality and stopped seizing. I ultimately ended up having a craniotomy to remove all the blood from the inside of my skull.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: On a path with 'blurry' beings on each side; floated down the path.

arrival.other_being_detail: “'blurry' beings on each side. They didn't look like 'people' but I knew they were.” Also saw deceased dog Molly.

environment.environment_other_detail: Colors described as “very earth tone.” Setting described as a “path.”

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Heard daughter crying “Mommy! Mommy! What's wrong?!” but stated “I didn't want to go.” Return appears triggered by dog jumping on chest and seizure stopping.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe headaches; later found blood inside skull requiring craniotomy; mentions stopping seizing upon return.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Passage described as a “path” with beings; encounter with deceased dog; heard daughter calling from far away; return coincided with dog jumping on chest and seizure stopping.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Path/being-lined passage and deceased pet encounter; no explicit OBE or light; return triggered by hearing daughter and physical stimulus (dog).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Encounter with deceased pet (dog Molly) on the path; return precipitated by living dog jumping on chest and licking mouth; seizure activity mentioned.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was on a path with 'blurry' beings on each side.” / “It felt so good there, no pain at all, so peaceful and cozy.” / “I didn't want to go. I won't go!” / “almost 'slammed' back in to reality”
